question_text: Nínú èdè Yorùbá, àwọn kọ̀ńsónàntì mélòò ni ó wà?
explanation: Àwọn kọ̀ńsónàntì ní èdè Yorùbá jẹ́ ẹ̀éjèèéèdúnrógún (18) tí a ń pè ní 'kọ̀ńsónàntì'. Àwọn ni: b, d, f, g, gb, h, j, k, l, m, n, p, r, s, ṣ, t, w, y.

question_text: Ìrò kọ̀ńsónàntì wo ni a ń pè ní 'ìrò àmùgbá' ní èdè Yorùbá?
explanation: Ìrò 'Gb' jẹ́ ìrò kọ̀ńsónàntì àmùgbá ti a kò lè ṣàpẹẹrẹ láìlò ìrò míìràn.

question_text: Nínú àwọn fáwẹ̀lì wọ̀nyí, èwo ni ó jẹ́ fáwẹ̀lì àárin?
explanation: Fáwẹ̀lì 'E' jẹ́ fáwẹ̀lì àárin nitori a ń pe e ní àárin ahọ́n.

question_text: Ọ̀kan lára àwọn ìrò ohun ti a ń pè ní 'ohun ìké' ni:
explanation: Ohun ìké (dó) jẹ́ ìrò ohun ti ó ga jùlọ nínú àwọn ìrò ohun méjèèje.

question_text: Nínú èdè Yorùbá, ìrò ohun wo ni a ń pè ní 'ohun àárin'?
explanation: Ohun àárin (ré) jẹ́ ìrò ohun ti ó wà láààrin ohun ìké àti ohun ìsàlè.

question_text: Nínú àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ wọ̀nyí, èwo ni ó jẹ́ ọ̀rọ̀-àrópọ̀-orúkọ onípẹẹjọ ìkéta?
explanation: Òun jẹ́ ọ̀rọ̀-àrópọ̀-orúkọ onípẹẹjọ ìkéta (third person singular).

question_text: Ọ̀kan lára àwọn ìlò èdè ti a ń pè ní 'àrótẹ̀lẹ̀ àfìwè' ni:
explanation: 'Bí... tí', 'gégé bí', àti 'dábí' jẹ́ àwọn ìlò èdè àrótẹ̀lẹ̀ àfìwè.

question_text: Nínú gẹ́ẹ̀sí èdè Yorùbá, ọ̀rọ̀-ìṣe ti ó ń fi ìṣe ti ó máa ń ṣẹlẹ̀ lọ́lá hàn ni:
explanation: 'Ó máa lọ' jẹ́ ọ̀rọ̀-ìṣe ti ó ń fi ìṣe ti ó máa ṣẹlẹ̀ lọ́lá hàn (future tense).

question_text: Ọ̀kan lára àwọn ìlò èdè ti a ń pè ní 'àrọ́pọ̀ àbìkò àfìwè' ni:
explanation: 'Tí... bá' jẹ́ ìlò èdè àrọ́pọ̀ àbìkò àfìwè ti a ń lo láti fi hàn ìgbà tí n̄ǹkan kan bá ṣẹlẹ̀.

question_text: Nínú àṣà Yorùbá, ìgbà tí a ń ṣe ìdùpẹ́ fún ìbí ọmọ ni a pè ní:
explanation: Ìdùpẹ́ ni a ń pè ìgbà tí a ń ṣe ìdùpẹ́ fún ìbí ọmọ ní àṣà Yorùbá.

question_text: Ọ̀kan lára àwọn ìwà ti a ń pè ní 'ìwà ọmọlúàbí' ni:
explanation: Ìwọ̀ntúnwọ̀nsin jẹ́ ìwà ọmọlúàbí nitori ó ń fi ìwọ̀nba àti ìmọ́totó hàn.

question_text: Nínú àṣà Yorùbá, ìgbà tí a ń ṣe ìṣẹ̀ṣe ìyárá ni a pè ní:
explanation: Ìyárá ni a ń pè ìgbà tí a ń ṣe ìṣẹ̀ṣe ìyárá fún ọmọ ní àṣà Yorùbá.

question_text: Ọ̀kan lára àwọn ìlò èdè ti a ń pè ní 'àfòmọ́ ìbáṣepọ̀' ni:
explanation: 'Ní', 'tí', àti 'sí' jẹ́ àwọn àfòmọ́ ìbáṣepọ̀ ní èdè Yorùbá.

question_text: Nínú ìtàn ìdilé Yorùbá, èdá wo ni a mò sí 'Olóri Ògun'?
explanation: Òyósí ni a mò sí 'Olóri Ògun' ní ìtàn ìdilé Yorùbá, ó jẹ́ aṣẹ́mọ̀ọ́ṣẹ́ ògun.

question_text: Ilú Yorùbá ti a mò sí 'Ilú Alààfin' ni:
explanation: Òyó ni a mò sí 'Ilú Alààfin' nitori ó jẹ́ orísun ìjọba Alààfin.

question_text: Ọ̀kan lára àwọn ààrẹ̀ ìlẹ̀ Yorùbá ti a mò sí 'Olóri Ìjọba' ni:
explanation: Alààfin ni a mò sí 'Olóri Ìjọba' ní ilẹ̀ Yorùbá, ó jẹ́ olóri ti ó ga jùlọ.

question_text: Nínú ìtàn ìdilé Yorùbá, èdá wo ni a mò sí 'Olóri Àwọn Ọba'?
explanation: Alààfin ni a mò sí 'Olóri Àwọn Ọba' ní ìtàn ìdilé Yorùbá.

question_text: Ìwé àpọ̀nlé ti a ń pè ní 'Ìwé Kọ́ni Àròkò Onímọ̀' ni a ń lo fún:
option_a: Kọ́ni bi a ṣe lé kọ àròkò onímọ̀
explanation: Ìwé Kọ́ni Àròkò Onímọ̀ ni a ń lo fún kọ́ni bi a ṣe lé kọ ìwé àròkò onímọ̀ ní èdè Yorùbá.

question_text: Nínú ìwé àròkò onímọ̀, ọ̀kan lára àwọn ohun ti a máa ń kọ̀ ni:
explanation: Àròkò onímọ̀ máa ń kọ̀ nípa ìmọ̀ ìjinlẹ̀ àti ìwádìí.

question_text: Ọ̀kan lára àwọn igbesé ti a ń gbà ní kọ́ni àròkò onímọ̀ ni:
explanation: Gbogbo igbesé ìṣájú, àárin, àti ìpàrí ni a ń gbà ní kọ́ni àròkò onímọ̀.

question_text: Nínú èdè Yorùbá, àwọn kọ̀ńsónàntì mélòò ni a ń pè ní 'kọ̀ńsónàntì àmùgbá'?
explanation: Kọ̀ńsónàntì àmùgbá ní èdè Yorùbá jẹ́ 'Gb' nikan.

question_text: Nínú àwọn fáwẹ̀lì wọ̀nyí, èwo ni ó jẹ́ fáwẹ̀lì ìhà?
explanation: Fáwẹ̀lì 'Ọ' jẹ́ fáwẹ̀lì ìhà nitori a ń pe e ní ìhà ẹnu.

question_text: Ìrò ohun wo ni a ń pè ní 'ohun ìsàlè'?
explanation: Ohun ìsàlè (míi) jẹ́ ìrò ohun ti ó kere jùlọ nínú àwọn ìrò ohun méjèèje.

question_text: Ọ̀kan lára àwọn ìlò èdè ti a ń pè ní 'àrọ́pọ̀ àbìkò ìgbà' ni:
explanation: 'Nígbà tí' jẹ́ ìlò èdè àrọ́pọ̀ àbìkò ìgbà ti a ń lo láti fi hàn ìgbà tí n̄ǹkan kan ṣẹlẹ̀.

question_text: Nínú àṣà Yorùbá, ìgbà tí a ń ṣe ìṣẹ̀ṣe ìṣọ̀fọ̀ ni a pè ní:
explanation: Ìṣọ̀fọ̀ ni a ń pè ìgbà tí a ń ṣe ìṣẹ̀ṣe ìṣọ̀fọ̀ fún òkù ní àṣà Yorùbá.

question_text: Ọ̀kan lára àwọn ìwà ti a ń pè ní 'ìwà ìbàjẹ́' ni:
explanation: Ìdíbi jẹ́ ìwà ìbàjẹ́ ti ó ń ṣìwà ẹ̀ṣẹ̀ hàn.

question_text: Nínú àṣà Yorùbá, ìgbà tí a ń ṣe ìṣẹ̀ṣe ìlánà fún òkù ni a pè ní:
explanation: Ìlánà ni a ń pè ìgbà tí a ń ṣe ìṣẹ̀ṣe ìlánà fún òkù ní àṣà Yorùbá.

question_text: Ọ̀kan lára àwọn ìlò èdè ti a ń pè ní 'àfòmọ́ ìbáṣepọ̀ ìgbà' ni:
explanation: 'Ní', 'tí', àti 'sí' jẹ́ àwọn àfòmọ́ ìbáṣepọ̀ ìgbà ní èdè Yorùbá.

question_text: Nínú ìtàn ìdilé Yorùbá, èdá wo ni a mò sí 'Olóri Ìlú'?
explanation: Bàbáàlé ni a mò sí 'Olóri Ìlú' ní ìtàn ìdilé Yorùbá.

question_text: Ilú Yorùbá ti a mò sí 'Ilú Àró' ni:
explanation: Ìbàdàn ni a mò sí 'Ilú Àró' nitori ìtàn ìdilé rẹ̀ ti ó ṣe àró àti òpin.

question_text: Ọ̀kan lára àwọn ààrẹ̀ ìlẹ̀ Yorùbá ti a mò sí 'Olóri Òṣẹ́' ni:
explanation: Òjé ni a mò sí 'Olóri Òṣẹ́' ní ìtàn ìdilé Yorùbá.

question_text: Nínú ìwé àròkò, ọ̀kan lára àwọn ìrú àròkò ni:
explanation: Gbogbo ìrú àròkò àlàyé, às̀à, àti onímọ̀ ni a ń kọ̀ ní èdè Yorùbá.

question_text: Ọ̀kan lára àwọn abala ìwé àròkò onímọ̀ ni:
explanation: Gbogbo abala ìṣájú, àárin, àti ìpàrí ni a ń lo ní ìwé àròkò onímọ̀.

question_text: Nínú kọ́ni àròkò às̀à, ọ̀kan lára àwọn ohun ti a máa ń kọ̀ ni:
explanation: Àròkò às̀à máa ń kọ̀ nípa àṣà, ìtàn ìdilé, àti ìṣe àgbà Yorùbá.

question_text: Nínú èdè Yorùbá, àwọn ìrò ófè mélòò ni ó wà?
explanation: Àwọn ìrò ófè ní èdè Yorùbá jẹ́ ẹ̀éjèèéèdúnrógún (18).

question_text: Ìrò kọ̀ńsónàntì wo ni a ń pè ní 'ìrò àgbá'?
explanation: Ìrò 'R' jẹ́ ìrò kọ̀ńsónàntì ti a ń pè ní 'ìrò àgbá' nitori a ń pe e ní àgbá ahọ́n.

question_text: Nínú àwọn fáwẹ̀lì wọ̀nyí, èwo ni ó jẹ́ fáwẹ̀lì àrọ́pọ̀?
explanation: Fáwẹ̀lì 'I' jẹ́ fáwẹ̀lì àrọ́pọ̀ nitori a ń pe e ní àrọ́pọ̀ ahọ́n.
